charts.title: TOI-1260 c: orbits around TOI-1260
charts.description: The orbits of TOI-1260's planets in this map from above, to scale, with TOI-1260 c highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Lam et al. 2023 (2023MNRAS.519.1437L), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname LAM_ET_AL_2023): P 7.493134 d

charts.title: TOI-1260 c: its transit
charts.description: TOI-1260 c crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (48, 74, 75) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 355867695, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, moved 8 minutes later to where TESS measures the dip, inside the published ephemeris's 3-sigma uncertainty of 11 minutes at these dates, then averaged in 8-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Aligned on TESS's dip, 8 min late; 8-min bins.
The ephemeris's own 1σ there is 4 min.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
